verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser publishes open practice-area pages for founders. They include an explainer that founders must adapt visas meant for other purposes and an O-1 page covering O-3 dependent eligibility. The firm also notes it wrote a founders' book, but nothing shows that book is free or ungated. missing for 10: evidence of substantial free startup-visa guides, criteria breakdowns, step-by-step process explainers, real case examples, and confirmation the content is not gated.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider publishes substantial free guides on startup visas — criteria breakdowns, process explainers, real examples — open to anyone, not gated lead bait

citations.quote: Foreign entrepreneurs and investors are often having to adapt visas intended for other purposes in order to use them for self-employment.
An accompanying spouse and/or any children under the age of 21 may be eligible to apply for an O-3 visa.
Our attorneys literally wrote the original book on the subject: Immigration for Startups: A Guide for Founders.
